title: Radix pass preconditions
statement: Let $L$ be a resource limit, let $����$ be a memory function from natural-number addresses to integers, let $A$ be a collection of radix-pass parameters, let $����$ be a list of natural-number indices, and let $k$ assign a natural-number key to each index. Assume that the space bound of $L$ is at most its word bound, the list has length $A.w$, and every entry in the list is less than $A.w$. The $A.w$ memory cells beginning at address $A.perm$ contain the list in order. For each $i<A.w$, the key cell at address $A.key+iA.stride+A.off$ is before $A.perm$ and contains the value $k(i)$, which is less than $A.nb$. Also, $A.perm+2A.w\le A.cnt$, the $A.nb+1$ counter cells beginning at $A.cnt$ end no later than $A.perm+A.R$, and $A.perm+A.R$ is at most the space bound of $L$.
